policy.reason: Physical testing of installed Android 97 and iOS 32 reproduced keyboard obstruction and unresolved iPhone route switching. The next PR #539 candidate dismisses the composer keyboard when opening call controls, stabilizes legacy route capability identity, and adds bounded native route request, result and immediate-output diagnostics. Fresh v7 binaries are required for both platforms, restricted to the existing Google Play and TestFlight internal tester audiences. Installed v6 and earlier cohorts remain immutable. Diagnostics are enabled only by the reviewed ios-internal-v2 build profile; this generation does not authorize OTA publication or public release.
